summary: George Russell's pole position sets up a Mercedes ambush on championship leader Kimi Antonelli, who limps to 16th after a qualifying crash and faces damage control on Baku's unforgiving street circuit. McLaren's sudden loss of pace with Lando Norris struggling in practice adds unpredictability to the midfield battle and threatens to fracture the team's title push. A strong recovery from Antonelli or a Mercedes one-two finish could dramatically reshape the championship narrative heading into the final stages of the season.
